landmarks: Single 90-degree west-to-north route, not a straight corridor
Root-wrapped corner pillar and branched overhead beams
Hanging berry vines and potted mushroom approximation
adaptations: 25x12x25 integer interpretation; world orientation west-to-north is an explicit convention.
Opaque solid inner-corner core and complete 625-column roof; no hidden room or diagonal shortcut.
Potted mushrooms on solid plinths replace naturally scattered mushrooms; full blocks approximate sloped roots.
Source-water side pool contained; no exterior forest, light shafts, particles, containers, loot or mechanisms.

cutaway_rules.roof: Display copy only: hide y>=11 for non-full views.
cutaway_rules.hero: Additionally hide x>=23 or z>=23 at y>=2. Solid inner core is NOT removed.
cutaway_rules.reverse_overview: Full source, no blocks hidden; reverse overview intentionally shows the opaque outer back of the wall core.
cutaway_rules.directional: At y>=2 hide north z<=1, south z>=23, west x<=1 or east x>=23 respectively. Interior wall core remains.
cutaway_rules.full: No blocks hidden: all three player views, roots-pool-detail, reverse-overview and four exterior views.
cutaway_rules.traceability: qa/render.json records source SHA, camera, cut mode, displayed records and screenshot SHA. Renderer constructs display structures in memory; final source is rehashed after rendering.
